methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Loombotic is a robotics and manufacturing company at an undisclosed development stage, founded by Lucas Crupi and Ethan Breit. The valuation universe for comparison includes one public company (ticker 277810.KQ) and eight private peers, among them Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. This comprises a sector peer set of ten total companies across Robotics & Manufacturing.

Application of peer-median valuation methodology proved infeasible for this analysis. Despite identifying ten same-sector peers, none met the three-datapoint minimum threshold when filtered by stage proximity or valuation tier. Specifically, zero same-stage comparables, zero adjacent-stage comparables, and zero similar-tier comparables emerged from the available dataset. An unfiltered all-sector median would introduce substantial comparability risk and obscure rather than clarify valuation bounds.

Given the constraint on quantitative triangulation, this analysis cannot support a specific valuation range at this time. The primary uncertainties are Loombotic's exact development stage and the absence of sufficiently similar precedent transactions or trading multiples. Advancement of this valuation would require either disclosure of stage and financial metrics to enable filtering of the private peer set, or identification of additional same-stage robotics companies with disclosed valuations. Further diligence on the company's technical differentiation and go-to-market trajectory would also inform comparable company weighting once a viable peer subset materializes.
